thread:
omar: Quick sync: new failure mode in continuous-batcher during tiny-request floods. Gateway fastpath admits but late-joins and kv-prefetch misses cause adapter queues to blow up.
priya: Is this different from last compaction-triggered incident?
omar: Related but amplification vector is request shape + reduced adapter buffer. Fastpath assumptions break.
kai: Proposed short fix: probabilistic admission_score that scales fastpath share with normalized adapter_queue_len + prefetch_miss. Keeps behavior smooth.
marta: Also need faster reclaim for reservations when batcher evicts. Current gc tick (1s) is too slow and causes dead reservations.
tess: Pseudocode for score?
kai: `score = max(min_floor, 1 - (ewma_queue_norm) - alpha*prefetch_miss)` sample per-request. Add hysteresis to avoid flapping.
priya: Observability: tag admission_path and emit fastpath_share per-tenant. Add alert: sustained adapter_queue_len>250 for 30s + prefetch_miss>0.1.
omar: Short plan: 1) kai add metric + tag; 2) marta reduce gc tick to 200ms and add reclaim_flag behind rollout; 3) omar implement admission_score with tenant overrides; 4) priya coordinate canary.
marta: Gate sync reclaim on tenant flag to avoid compaction tail on prod. Canary first.
tess: Long-term: reservation-lease-hybrid RFC (heartbeat + TTL fallback) to eliminate dead reservations. Omar will draft.
priya: Runbook stub: if adapter queue rising, force microbatch for tenant, increase queue cap, or flip reclaim_flag.
deploy-bot: deploy/gateway v1.3.0 admission_flag=canary rolled to 3 nodes
